title: How Graco is Celebrating 100 Years Through Community Giving
body_markdown:
## How Graco is Celebrating 100 Years Through Community Giving


For the last century, Graco has developed innovative fluid handling solutions that help customers improve productivity, increase efficiency and move materials that matter. As the company celebrates its centennial, it is also reflecting on the importance of investing in the people and communities that help move the world forward.


#### The impact of the Graco Foundation


Supporting employees, strengthening communities and creating opportunities for future generations have long been part of who Graco is. Through the Graco Foundation, the company supports employee volunteer programs, nonprofit partnerships and community initiatives focused on education, workforce development and community engagement.


#### A $1 million commitment to Minnesota nonprofits


As part of Graco’s centennial celebration, the Graco Foundation committed $1 million to Minnesota nonprofit organizations. Ten organizations were selected to receive $100,000 grants to help strengthen their long-term sustainability and expand their impact in the communities they serve.


The recipient organizations include:


- AccessAbility, Inc.
- Achieve Twin Cities
- American Indian OIC
- Avenues for Youth
- Avivo
- Habitat for Humanity
- Hearts & Hammers
- Minnesota Diversified Industries
- Summit Academy OIC


These grants reflect the Graco Foundation’s commitment to supporting nonprofit organizations that create opportunities, strengthen communities and improve lives across Minnesota.


[Learn more](https://investors.graco.com/news-releases/news-release-details/graco-foundation-marks-companys-centennial-1-million-commitment) about the Graco Foundation’s centennial commitment to Minnesota nonprofits.


#### Giving beyond the centennial year


While the centennial grants mark a significant milestone, Graco’s commitment to community impact extends well beyond its 100-year anniversary. Through the Graco Foundation and employee-driven initiatives, the company continues to support organizations and causes that make a difference.


-


Dollars for Doers: A program that recognizes employee volunteer service hours by providing financial support to eligible nonprofit organizations.


-


Graco Gives: A matching gift program that amplifies employee donations to eligible nonprofit organizations.


-


Metro Paint-A-Thon: An annual volunteer opportunity that allows employees to partner with Hearts & Hammers to help paint and maintain homes for residents in need.


*Graco employee volunteering in the 2025 Paint-A-Thon.*


Together, these initiatives help extend the impact of employee volunteering and charitable giving throughout the communities where they live and work.


#### Building stronger communities for the next 100 years


Since its creation, Graco has focused on moving materials that matter. Through the Graco Foundation, that commitment extends beyond its products and to the people and communities in which it serves.


As Graco celebrates 100 years of innovation and growth, the company remains committed to creating a lasting impact for the years to come.


[Learn more](https://www.graco.com/us/en/about-graco/foundation.html) about the Graco Foundation’s community initiatives and charitable efforts.
